component.name: Kerberos Tickets
component.summary: Keep your Kerberos ticket alive and see when it expires

description.p: A small tray application for MIT Kerberos on the Linux desktop. It shows the time remaining on your ticket-granting ticket, renews it before it expires, and lets you sign in, switch accounts and destroy tickets from a native GTK window.

Accounts can renew unattended from a keytab, or from a password kept in the Secret Service (GNOME Keyring / KWallet). The same state is available to scripts and status bars through krbctl status --json.

ul.li: Tray icon over StatusNotifierItem — works in Noctalia, Waybar, KDE Plasma and GNOME's AppIndicator extension
Automatic renewal shortly before expiry, with backoff when the KDC is unreachable
Cerberus tray icon whose colour shows the ticket state at a glance
Creates keytabs from a password, so no ktutil incantations
Notifications on expiring, expired and renewal failure
Scriptable: human and JSON output from the command line

description.p: First release: tray icon, GTK4 window, auto-renew, keytab and password accounts, and JSON status output for status bars.
